# NippleJS 1.0.4

Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/nipplejs/v/1.0.4
Upstream: https://github.com/yoannmoinet/nipplejs
License: MIT (see LICENSE).

`index.js` is the npm package's `dist/index.mjs`, renamed for this static server's JavaScript MIME mapping. Only the unavailable source map reference was removed. No runtime dependencies or CDN requests.
